bio:
VibeBeats is a small music toy in the browser: click around, build a pattern, let it loop. No accounts, no saving, just a few minutes of noise.

One page, no install. By Tront (Trent Sterling), who also built the lo-fi generator next door.
title: VibeBeats by Tront
list:
• VibePong: Hyper-stylised CPU versus CPU Pong with dynamic physics and powerups.
